## ConnectionService.processAck() method

Process a received ack message. This will update the state of the connection to Completed if this is not already the case.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processAck(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<AckMessage>): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```
